update sys_role
name=#{sysRole.name},
`key`=#{sysRole.key},
data_scope=#{sysRole.dataScope},
status=#{sysRole.status},
remark=#{sysRole.remark}
remark=null
where id=#{sysRole.id}
mapper.select: select sr.id, sr.`key`, sr.name from sys_role sr left join sys_user_role sur on sur.role_id = sr.id where sur.user_id=#{userId}

select `id`, `name`, `key`, `status`, `data_scope`, `create_time` from sys_role
`name` like concat('%',#{dto.name},'%')
`key` like concat('%',#{dto.key},'%')
and `status` = #{dto.status}
and `data_scope` = #{dto.dataScope}
and `deleted`=0
order by `create_time` desc

select distinct r.id, r.name, r.key, r.status, r.deleted, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.remark from sys_role r left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id left join sys_user u on u.id = ur.user_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 and ur.user_id = #{userId}
